A query transitions to WAHM if and only if deterministic BFS traversal discovers an explicit refutation path or property closure non-membership in K. If an entity or property is absent from K, the system transitions to SHAKK and unconditionally defers to the LLM without overriding. Because BFS graph reachability on a finite directed acyclic graph is sound and complete, a valid entailment path can never be evaluated as false, and an unreachable path can never be evaluated as true. Therefore, an override is triggered exclusively upon formal graph proof, guaranteeing FP = 0 strictly and Precision = 100.0% invariant across all LLM models and sample sizes.
